text: 首先，40岁基本上生育能力就没了。
en: First of all, by 40 one's fertility is basically gone.

text: 就算还有，那已经是超高龄产妇，风险高、畸形率高、产后恢复慢。
en: Even if there is any, she is already an advanced-age mother, with high risk, a high rate of deformities, and slow postnatal recovery.

text: 对于还想要孩子的男性当然不会考虑了。
en: Men who still want children certainly will not consider it.

text: 第二，40岁女人经历丰富，没有20来岁的小姑娘好相处。
en: Second, a 40-year-old woman has rich experience and is not as easy to get along with as a 20-something girl.

text: 小姑娘可能出手大方几次就能获得芳心，而要搞定40岁女人所花的时间精力金钱都超过小姑娘，谁也不傻。
en: A young girl might win one's heart after a few generous gestures, but the time, energy and money spent on winning over a 40-year-old woman all exceed that for a young girl—no one is a fool.

text: 第三，40岁女人的颜值也不能打了。
en: Third, a 40-year-old woman's looks are no longer competitive either.

text: 无论她保养的多好，40岁肯定也比不了年轻小姑娘。
en: No matter how well she maintains herself, at 40 she certainly cannot compare with a young girl.

text: 对女人来说，20岁的10年是黄金期、30岁的10年是白银期、40岁的10年是青铜期。
en: For a woman, the decade of her 20s is the golden period, the decade of her 30s is the silver period, and the decade of her 40s is the bronze period.

text: 而对于40岁男人而言，人生阅历、精力、人脉积累等综合起来正处于黄金期，基本上在各个单位都是骨干大拿，你让黄金段位的去匹配青铜这肯定不可能啊
en: But for a 40-year-old man, life experience, energy and the accumulation of connections combined put him right in his golden period; basically he is a backbone and a top expert in whatever unit he is in. Asking someone at the gold tier to match with bronze—that is simply impossible.

text: 事实上，只有二十几岁初婚的时候，大部分男女才会考虑同龄人。
en: In fact, it is only at one's first marriage in one's twenties that most men and women consider people of the same age.

text: 到了三十大几岁，男性择偶的时候就会选择偏小的女性了，因为女性的黄金生育年龄就那十来年，生育价值在35以后直线下降。
en: Once a man is in his late thirties, he will choose younger women when selecting a partner, because a woman's golden childbearing years are just those ten-odd years, and her reproductive value drops sharply after 35.

text: 如果女性三十多岁想找个相同条件，甚至条件比自己好的男人，只能找年龄大的，或者找条件比自己差很多但是年龄比自己小的。
en: If a woman in her thirties wants to find a man of equal or even better conditions, she can only look for an older man, or a man much worse off but younger than herself.

text: 而男性，会选择生育价值高的，条件会放在第二位，因为这个年龄段的男性已经解决了温饱甚至小康问题了（个别废物不在此内）
en: Men, on the other hand, will choose those with high reproductive value, putting conditions second, because men of this age have already secured their basic needs or even a comfortable living (except for the occasional good-for-nothing).

text: 不管承认不承认，动物性决定的现实就是如此。
en: Whether you admit it or not, the reality determined by our animal nature is just so.

text: 当然个例还是有的，比如所谓“真爱”。
en: Of course there are exceptions, such as so-called 'true love'.

text: 而现实中，三十多岁还是未婚过的，除非遇到重大变故耽误婚姻的意外情况，大部分男女都是不太正常的，包括但不限于条件太差、长相太差、性格问题、眼高于顶、智商在及格线以下等等。
en: Yet in reality, those in their thirties who have never married—unless delayed by some major upheaval or unexpected circumstance—are mostly abnormal, including but not limited to poor conditions, poor looks, personality issues, impossibly high standards, an IQ below the pass line, and so on.

text: 我是怎么得出这个结论的呢？
en: How did I arrive at this conclusion?

text: 大学读书和工作了很多年，大学生、硕士及以上的女生交往过好多，基本上，高于大学本科学历的女生想一起学外语很简单，只是思想和性格有点奇怪，最后都是住了一段时间分开了，到了现在偶尔还能抽空一起学习一下外语。
en: I studied at university and worked for many years, and have dated many female university students, and those at master's level and above. Basically, it is easy to study foreign languages together with girls above bachelor's level; it is just that their thinking and personality are a bit odd, and in the end we lived together for a while and then parted. To this day we occasionally still find time to study foreign languages together.

text: 而我自己就是一定意义上的“浪子”或者“海王”，在无数个夜晚之后三十几岁找了个小我十岁的大学生结婚。
en: And I myself am, in a certain sense, a 'playboy' or a 'sea king', and after countless nights I married a university student ten years my junior in my thirties.

text: 我相信有因果报应的，在辜负了很多女生之后才结婚，导致结婚没两年就离了。
en: I believe in karma; after letting many girls down I got married, which led to a divorce within two years of marriage.

text: 踏入相亲市场现在有三四个月了，大于35岁的排除，大于三十岁未婚的排除，有孩子的排除，见面了大约四十几个，有三分之一对我特别满意，有三分之一对我感觉良好可以继续交往，有三分之一没什么感觉。
en: I have been in the blind-date market for three or four months now. I excluded those over 35, those over 30 and unmarried, and those with children. I met about forty-something; a third were especially satisfied with me, a third felt good about me and could continue seeing me, and a third felt nothing.

text: 现在从特别满意里挑了个小我五岁，个头比我还高一点的女生（穿平底鞋约178）继续交往准备结婚。
en: Now, from those especially satisfied I have picked a girl five years my junior, a bit taller than me (about 178 in flat shoes), to continue seeing with a view to marriage.

text: 通过这三十几年的观察和总结，现在的体制内单身女性很多，普遍三十岁往上，高不成低不就耽误了。
en: Through these thirty-odd years of observation and summary, there are now many single women within the system; generally they are over 30, and have been held back by being unable to reach higher and unwilling to settle for lower.

text: 我现在从商，体制内介绍并接触过七个，同龄自己有事业的介绍接触了有五个，这些女性普遍认为自己条件好，要找个同龄甚至比自己小的相同条件的男性，这是不太现实的。
en: I am now in business. I have been introduced to and met seven within the system, and five of my own age who have their own careers. These women generally think they are in good shape and want to find a man of the same age or even younger, with equal conditions—which is not very realistic.

text: 我现在温饱不愁，会把配偶的生育价值放在前面，不像二十多岁爱情至上了，事实上爱情并不能解决问题，而维持婚姻的条件有三个:
en: I am now free from worry about food and clothing, and will put my spouse's reproductive value first, unlike in my twenties when love was paramount. In fact love cannot solve problems, and there are three conditions for sustaining a marriage:

text: 第一物质基础，贫贱夫妻百事哀。
en: First, a material foundation: poor couples grieve over everything.

text: 这是现实，不是物质化，但是要有度。
en: This is reality, not materialism, but there must be a limit.

text: 第二情感基础和交流，这个可以选择三观相近的培养。
en: Second, an emotional foundation and communication; for this one can choose and cultivate someone with similar values.

text: 三观相近比爱情更持久。
en: Shared values last longer than love.

text: 第三夫妻生活和谐，这是个润滑剂。
en: Third, a harmonious conjugal life; this is a lubricant.

text: 题目说的是40岁，而四十多岁对生育后代的需求是不同的。
en: The title speaks of 40, but those in their forties have a different need for bearing offspring.

text: 如果不需要再繁衍后代，那么年龄属于次要条件了。
en: If there is no need to reproduce further, then age becomes a secondary condition.

text: 如果有需求，那么35岁或者37岁的女性就是个坎儿，四十多岁只能学外语，而不能考个好成绩了。
en: If there is such a need, then a woman of 35 or 37 is a threshold; in one's forties one can only study foreign languages, but cannot get good grades.

text: 没有前提的问题是没有意义的，我只能就自己经历说一点。
en: A question without premises is meaningless; I can only say a little based on my own experience.

text: 我工作经历是从高校到底层销售，又到工厂下车间，到开工厂到经商，大城市小城市农村都呆过，朋友三教九流都有，全国中东部地区基本上走遍了，见到和经历的应该比同龄人多。
en: My work experience went from a university to bottom-rung sales, then to working on the factory floor, to running a factory and then into business. I have lived in big cities, small cities and the countryside; I have friends from all walks of life, and have basically travelled across the central and eastern regions of the country. What I have seen and experienced should be more than most of my peers.

text: 样本也多，那些单一经历或者从网上获取信息的就不要来比较了。
en: My sample is also large; those with a single experience or who get information from the internet should not come to compare.

text: 最后祝愿大家2025一切顺利。
en: Finally, I wish everyone all the best in 2025.

en: Because those whose aim is marriage and those who seek only a one-night pleasure consider different things and can give differently. It is not that the one-night-pleasure person has better conditions than you, but that he is willing to give.

en: Anyway, since longevity is not considered, it is fine to give more, fine to defer completely, fine to simp, fine to spend lavishly in the short term, providing plenty of emotional value and even material conditions—as long as you get to base, you succeed.

text: 所以这个时候的女性会觉得出轨对象更体贴，更理解自己，更重视自己，感觉遇到真爱了:）心理得到极大满足，感性变的更感性，而失去理性。
en: So at this time the woman feels the affair partner is more considerate, more understanding, more attentive to her, and feels she has met true love :) Her psychology is greatly satisfied, her emotionality becomes yet more emotional, and she loses her reason.

text: （也因此很多出轨女性跟出轨对象真正结婚之后，会觉得男方变了很多，变自私变不体贴，最后苦果自己吃，反过来还说男性得到了就不珍惜。
en: (Thus many cheating women, after actually marrying their affair partner, feel the man has changed a lot—become selfish and inconsiderate—and in the end eat the bitter fruit themselves, yet turn around and say that men stop cherishing once they have got them.

text: 而结婚，要考虑平等相待，要考虑生活的持续付出和方方面面，比如家庭、老人、孩子、工作等等等等，做不到舔狗，会很现实，会考虑义务和责任。
en: But marriage requires treating each other as equals, and considering the sustained effort of life and every aspect—family, elders, children, work and so on and so forth. One cannot be a simp, and will be very realistic, considering duty and responsibility.

text: 所以大多数女性在婚后出轨，仅仅是出轨对象所谓的“体贴”“大方”，甚至低质量男性也很容易上垒。
en: So most women who cheat after marriage do so merely because of the affair partner's so-called 'considerateness' and 'generosity'; even low-quality men easily get to base.

text: [捂脸]因此吧，我觉得三观一致太重要了，大于颜值，大于感情，大于爱，大于条件。
en: [facepalm] Therefore, I think sharing the same values is too important—greater than looks, greater than feelings, greater than love, greater than conditions.

text: 寄希望于“道德”，是不太现实的。
en: Placing hope in 'morality' is not very realistic.

text: 也希望你结婚过日子，不要那么太执着于颜值和身高。
en: I also hope that in your married life you will not be so fixated on looks and height.

text: 两个人相处的时候，你要是觉得有点踮着脚尖，大概率以后没有好果子吃。
en: When two people get along, if you feel you are a bit on tiptoe, chances are you will come to no good end later.
